t6-role: Amos completed his CELTA in 2017 and leaped into the satisfying and sometimes bewildering world of the teaching and testing of English. With his love of laughter and dedication to his students, he has found his happy place in the IH classroom. Amos is currently the librarian, CELTA administrator and the social programme coordinator.
t5-role: Matthew hails from the fair shores of the British Isles. He embarked upon a career in the language of his motherland with exuberance and inspiration. Moving with ease between administrative duties, testing, and the teaching of English, Matthew is equally happy educating his learners in the classroom or hiking in the clean mountain air.
heading: About IH Johannesburg
t4-role: Jearóid completed his CELTA in October 2011 and began working at IH Language Lab in February 2012. He has an Honours Degree in Dramatic Art from WITS and has worked various jobs including journalist, bureau de change supervisor and barman. Jearóid feels he has found his calling in teaching English as a foreign language and looks forward to a long and fruitful career in the EFL.
t3-role: Maloba completed his CELTA in January 2013 and began his teaching career at IH Johannesburg in February 2014 after completing his postgraduate studies at WITS. He is currently the Marketing Manager as well as the Centre Exams Manager for the Cambridge ESOL and OET exams.
t2-role: Alessia is a CELTA teacher trainer and language teacher. She completed her DELTA in 2015 and has been doing teacher trainer since. Alessia is also an assessor for Aviation English and for Cambridge ESOL exams. Alessia started teaching at IH in 2010. She’s been involved in language teaching in one form or another since leaving University.
cta-heading: Come and see the school — or ask us anything.
t1-role: Annie is the Director of Studies and Head of Teacher Training. She is a CELTA trainer, a CELTA Assessor, trains teachers of younger learners, an Aviation English examiner and a Cambridge ESOL examiner. She has been with International House Johannesburg since 1996.  She has also taught in the UK, Portugal and Spain.

intro:
Welcome to International House Johannesburg - The Language Lab, the premier destination for English language learning and teaching in Africa. As an affiliate of the globally renowned International House World Organisation (IHWO), we uphold the highest standards of language learning and teacher training, committed to delivering unparalleled quality in education.

Nestled in Parktown, Johannesburg, our institution offers students a unique opportunity to learn English in an environment that celebrates the city's multicultural vibrancy. Our dedicated faculty, all Cambridge-certified, bring a passionate and enthusiastic approach to our courses, ensuring an engaging and rewarding educational experience.

We are proud to bear the standard of international recognition. Our teacher training department offers the Cambridge University affiliated CELTA and DELTA English teaching certificates, catering to those aspiring to teach English as a foreign language. These highly regarded qualifications open doors to teaching opportunities worldwide, strengthening our graduates' professional portfolios.

Moreover, IH Johannesburg holds the distinction of being the only independent IELTS (International English Language Testing System) testing centre in South Africa. The IELTS is a vital stepping stone for individuals wishing to immigrate to countries such as Australia, the UK, and Canada, or for those seeking admission to many universities globally.

Further extending our accreditation, we are the sole centre in Gauteng that offers the globally recognised Cambridge ESOL exams. These examinations provide an internationally acknowledged proof of English language proficiency, adding substantial value to our students' academic and professional pursuits.

Our language learning facilities are state-of-the-art, equipped with digital resources, a well-stocked library, and comfortable classrooms. We foster a nurturing and dynamic learning environment, enriched by our vibrant social programme and the unique opportunity to live with English-speaking host families.

At IH Johannesburg, we are more than a language school; we are a beacon of excellence in English language teaching and testing. We invite you to join our diverse community of learners and explore the world of English with us. Let's embark on this enriching journey together.
social-text: The social programme takes place on the last Friday of each course. This is a chance for all students and staff to socialise, experience some interesting places and have some fun. Activities include bowling, Johannesburg Zoo, Gold Reef City, Soweto tour, white water rafting, Montecasino Bird Gardens, accrobranching, cultural luncheons and more.
